name: guardrails
description: Data-driven guardrails for agent Bash commands: rules (deny or warn, per-command retry, session modes) live in global or per-project state and are enforced by one PreToolUse hook that parses each command in process with ast-grep-py from a runtime it installs by itself (program, args and match.ast rules; regex rules read the raw text). Nothing is active until you install presets with the setup skill.
